mapper.sql: SELECT br.id, br.user_id AS userId, br.book_id AS bookId, br.borrow_time AS borrowTime, br.due_time AS dueTime, br.return_time AS returnTime, br.status, br.renew_count AS renewCount, br.borrow_days_snapshot, br.max_renew_count_snapshot, br.renew_days_snapshot, br.fine_per_day_snapshot, br.overdue_days AS overdueDays, br.fine_amount AS fineAmount, u.username, u.nickname, b.title AS bookTitle, b.author AS bookAuthor, c.name AS categoryName, CASE WHEN br.status = 'BORROWING' AND DATE(br.due_time) < DATE(CONVERT_TZ(UTC_TIMESTAMP(), '+00:00', '+08:00')) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS overdue, DATEDIFF(br.due_time, NOW()) AS remainDays FROM borrow_record br INNER JOIN user u ON br.user_id = u.id INNER JOIN book b ON br.book_id = b.id LEFT JOIN category c ON b.category_id = c.id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO borrow_record (user_id, book_id, borrow_time, due_time, status, renew_count, overdue_days, fine_amount, borrow_days_snapshot, max_renew_count_snapshot, renew_days_snapshot, fine_per_day_snapshot) VALUES (#{userId}, #{bookId}, #{borrowTime}, #{dueTime}, #{status}, #{renewCount}, 0, 0, #{borrowDaysSnapshot}, #{maxRenewCountSnapshot}, #{renewDaysSnapshot}, #{finePerDaySnapshot})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM borrow_record WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'BORROWING'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM borrow_record WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND book_id = #{bookId} AND status = 'BORROWING'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM borrow_record WHERE book_id = #{bookId}
mapper.update: UPDATE borrow_record SET due_time = #{dueTime}, renew_count = renew_count + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'BORROWING'
UPDATE borrow_record SET status = 'RETURNED', return_time = #{returnTime}, overdue_days = #{overdueDays}, fine_amount = #{fineAmount} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'BORROWING'
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM borrow_record WHERE book_id = #{bookId} AND status = 'BORROWING'
